chunks: Sa'd, from Abī Ja'far, from his father, from 'Abd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, who said:
“When you perform salat (prayer), then perform salat (prayer) in your sandals if they are taharah (ritually pure), for indeed that is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition).”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while wearing sandals if they are ritually pure?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing salat (prayer) in sandals is permissible when they are taharah (ritually pure), and it identifies this practice as part of the sunnah (prophetic tradition). Its significance is in clarifying a practical ruling related to clothing and what may be worn during salat (prayer).
